description: This file defines the StaticContentCacheManagerImpl class which manages caching of static content data such as CSS, JS, and digital data using Infinispan cache. It extends CacheManagerImpl and follows singleton pattern to provide a single instance. The class mainly handles cache initialization and access.

classes.name: StaticContentCacheManagerImpl
classes.description: Cache manager class for handling static content data using Infinispan cache, implemented as a singleton.
